items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: he was with Lawrence Duhé and Roy Palmer

ctx.x: That period 1921 to 1924 is very confusing, because Joe Oliver had the band in Chicago with Johnny and Baby Dodds, but before that he was with Lawrence Duhé and Roy Palmer and all that gang. Then most of them seemed to come out here... I don't know why he broke that band up, but most of them seem to have come out here. I mean, Ram was out here quite early, wasn't he? Minor Hall.

Well, like I said, Ram first came here I know in 1921 with Joe Oliver. And I seen a picture (I don't know how I got that picture, if somebody gave it to me) of Kid Ory and Tudie standing on the dock in San Francisco...
